review_scope: Bounded source-to-record review of reporting triggers and clocks, phased-rollout approval conditions, and cure qualifications.

clauses_reviewed.record_rule: The agreement commences with Phase One. Each subsequent phase occurs only upon written Office approval. The Office reviews the size and location of the Phase Two student group.
The participant notifies the Office within 24 hours of an incident that results in harm to a user's health, safety, or financial well-being.

Cure-period forbearance depends on a good-faith effort to follow the curing procedure. The procedure requires immediate reporting of activity constituting an incident and good-faith efforts to remediate the incident and resulting harm and to avoid repeat incidents.

linked_obligations_reviewed.result: No correction required; it already limits written approval to advancement to each subsequent phase.
No correction required; it already limits the 24-hour rule to incidents resulting in harm.
